top_backlinks.title: Alternaleaf Australia | Trusted Alternative Healthcare Services
Alternaleaf Patient Portal | For A Better You

notes.tagline: The category leader. Best-funded, most refined digital presence in Australian medicinal cannabis — and the safest legal posture.

visual_system: Cream / sage palette — clinical and calm, never green-leaf cliché.
Real photography of patients and clinicians, never stock imagery.
Generous whitespace, soft rounded corners, large serif headings.
No 'buy now' buttons anywhere — only 'book consult'.
site_architecture: /post/ — long-form city and condition explainers, many redirected.
Patient portal and help centre on dedicated subdomains (patient., support.).
tone_compliance: Talks about consultations and eligibility, never products.
Uses TGA / SAS terminology correctly; cites approvals carefully.
No specific-condition claims on commercial pages.
Reviews page is real Trustpilot embeds — third-party proof.

eeat.notes: Clinician oversight is signalled visually but bylines on the wellness hub lack credentials. Schema coverage is partial — Organization and FAQ are present, MedicalCondition / MedicalWebPage are not.

steal.note: Marketing site for acquisition, portal for retention, Zendesk for long-tail informational. The support hub alone earns 4.4K visits/mo from defensive informational queries.
Adopt their language: consultations, eligibility, prescribers — never products, never claims. The 'safe' voice is the price of being taken seriously at scale.
Their best-linked assets are city-specific cannabis explainers that publishers can cite without risk. Replicable in months.
1,128 location keywords for them yet only 2,447 visits — they own the inventory but not the rankings. Suburb-level pSEO is uncontested.

steal.play: Condition-led E-E-A-T pages with clinician bios
steal.note: 53 chronic-pain keywords for 1 visit/mo proves they can't write this content aggressively. We can — with proper authorship, dated reviews and citations.
Both rank in top 3 and earn category visits. Hellomello should publish a transparent /pricing and a real-review /reviews page on day one.

avoid.evidence: 21 /hub/ pages → 82 visits/mo. Sleep, dopamine, energy — wellness topics unrelated to cannabis, ranking nowhere.
1,597 keywords sitting at #51–100 produce zero traffic. Publishing volume without depth is a tax, not an asset.
1,310 brand keywords carry 70.6K of 78.5K visits (90%). If a competitor outranks them on a single non-brand category term, the moat doesn't help.
Perth ranks for 74 keywords and earns 9 visits/mo; Adelaide and Canberra are token. Listing 'Australia' is not a location strategy.

implications: The structure is replicable — three subdomains, conservative copy, transparent commercial pages.
The gaps are real and undefended — conditions, capital cities, near-me, clinical authority.
Speed matters: Alternaleaf's compliance posture slows them down. Hellomello's window is the next two release cycles.

gap_matrix.comment: Their copy is restricted — we can author it.
Owned inventory, no rankings — easy to displace.
